title: Printing
summary: Print jobs that fail and spooler problems.

events.title: A document failed to print
events.meaning: A print job failed on a printer. The message names the document, the user and the printer.
events.causes: A printer that is offline, a driver problem or a damaged job.
events.next: Clear the print queue, restart the print spooler and print again. Update the printer driver if it repeats.

events.title: The print spooler could not load a plug-in
events.meaning: The print spooler failed to load a module, often from a printer driver.
events.causes: A damaged or incompatible printer driver.
events.next: Reinstall or update the printer driver named in the message.
